title: Electric Service by Rate Schedule: Budget Billing, PrePay Power, Deposit Tier and Patron Class by Schedule
content:
The schedule assigned to an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account decides which other cooperative programs the account may join, which Security Deposits tier is assessed for it, and into which Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) patron class its patronage is allocated.

| Term | R | RS | FH | GS-1 | GS-3 | IR | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| May enroll in a Budget Billing plan | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| May enroll in a PrePay Power plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Security deposit tier assessed | Residential Standard Deposit | Seasonal Residence Deposit | Farm Service Deposit | General Service Deposit | General Service Deposit | Irrigation and Large Power Deposit | Irrigation and Large Power Deposit |
| Capital credit patron class | Residential Patron Class | Seasonal Patron Class | Farm Patron Class | General Service Patron Class | General Service Patron Class | Irrigation Patron Class | Large Power Patron Class |

Column key: R is Schedule R Residential Service; RS is Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service; FH is Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; GS-1 is Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; GS-3 is Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; IR is Schedule IR Irrigation Service; LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

### Reading the table

- Budget Billing is open to Schedules R, FH and GS-1 only.
- PrePay Power is open to Schedules R, RS, FH and GS-1 only.
- Schedules GS-1 and GS-3 share the General Service Deposit and the General Service Patron Class; Schedules IR and LP share the Irrigation and Large Power Deposit but are allocated to different patron classes (Irrigation Patron Class and Large Power Patron Class).

### Hypothetical example

A member moving a farm home from Schedule R to Schedule FH (hypothetical) changes the account's deposit tier from Residential Standard Deposit to Farm Service Deposit and its patron class from Residential Patron Class to Farm Patron Class; the account remains open to both Budget Billing and PrePay Power.
